home.title: MCP Test: MCP Inspector Online & Playground | mcptest.io
home.description: Test remote MCP servers online for free, with no install or sign-up. Check connections, OAuth, CORS and tools in your browser, then share a report.

catalog.title: Remote MCP Server Catalog | mcptest.io
catalog.description: Browse public remote MCP servers by category and authentication. Each listing shows its transport, protocol, browser access and latest validation result.

discovery.title: MCP Discovery Checker: Server Cards and Registry | mcptest.io
discovery.description: Find every remote MCP server a domain advertises in Server Cards, OAuth metadata, the MCP Registry and the catalog. Each document is validated.

report.title: MCP Release-Readiness Report | mcptest.io
report.description: Run a release-readiness report on a remote MCP server: shipping blockers, client compatibility, OAuth and tool risk, saved in your browser.

submit.title: Submit a Remote MCP Server to the Catalog | mcptest.io
submit.description: Check your remote MCP endpoint, describe it and submit it to the mcptest.io catalog. A maintainer reviews each submission as a pull request.

learn.title: Learn MCP
learn.description: Source-backed MCP guides: how MCP works, connecting clients to remote servers, OAuth, building and testing a server, and decoding errors.
learn.summary: Guides to understanding MCP, connecting clients to remote servers, building and testing your own server, and debugging errors.

breaking-changes.title: MCP Breaking Change Checker for tools/list | mcptest.io
breaking-changes.description: Compare two tools/list results, or a live endpoint with an earlier listing, and see which tool, prompt and resource changes break clients.

oauth-check.title: MCP OAuth Checker: Test Discovery Before Login | mcptest.io
oauth-check.description: Check the OAuth discovery an MCP client runs before login: challenge, resource and authorization server metadata, resource match, registration and PKCE.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy | mcptest.io
privacy-policy.description: Read the mcptest.io privacy policy, including how server connections, test history, local browser storage, and website analytics are handled.

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service | mcptest.io
terms-of-service.description: Review the terms for using mcptest.io to connect to, inspect, test, and debug remote Model Context Protocol servers.

contact.title: Contact | mcptest.io
contact.description: Contact the mcptest.io team for technical support, product questions, feedback, or help testing remote Model Context Protocol servers.
